item.title: Motel 6 Owner Pulls Back From Hotel Owners Group
item.description: New ownership appears to be nudging Motel 6 toward a different playbook, dialing back traditional industry ties and emphasizing targeted advocacy. This may leave some franchise owners to wonder whether the pace of change feels too fast.

item.title: Amadeus Acquired SkyLink to Infuse Its Products With Conversational AI
item.description: Amadeus has always been out-front about the adoption of new technologies, and this acquisition will strengthen its position in conversational AI.

item.title: Why Travel Can’t Hide From Activist Investors Anymore
item.description: The post-Covid boom hid deep performance gaps across travel. Now it's fading, and those gaps are exactly what activist hedge funds exploit best.

item.title: Accor and Air France-KLM Face Higher Debt Costs After Missing Climate Targets
item.description: The financial hit isn't big, but the disclosures reveal the reasons companies may miss climate targets.

item.title: Saudi’s Red Sea Airport Aims for 50:50 Split Between Domestic and International Travelers
item.description: The facility has an ambitious goal to receive one million passengers by 2030.

item.title: Hotel Execs Reveal New Revenue Priority: Making More from Loyalty
item.description: Loyalty is no longer just about repeat stays. Hotel execs are increasingly pitching it as a revenue engine that can keep growing even when room pricing slows.

item.title: Barcelona to Double Hotel Tax
item.description: The revenue from Barcelona's big hotel tax increase could go a long way in helping the city confront its housing crisis — assuming travelers aren't put off by more expensive stays.

item.title: Vrbo Guests Can Pay Fees to Get Refunds When Rain Ruins a Stay
item.description: Vrbo is testing a new way to give travelers peace of mind with a weather-guarantee option powered by WeatherPromise.

item.title: India’s Next Aviation Boom Will Be Handled by New Airports, Not Bigger Ones
item.description: India is getting multiple airports in key hubs in response to traffic growth, but any major demand disruption in a newly growing India market could lead to this model falling apart.

item.title: Prism Acquires 10 Sonder Properties to Bring Belvilla Brand to U.S.: Exclusive
item.description: Prism may list in India, but it is evolving into an India-U.S. hospitality platform, using the extended-stay demand to support its next phase of international expansion.
